name: IC Analog Amplifier — 2V — MSOP
description: A cluster of 4 tier-A analog amplifier ICs in surface-mount MSOP packages with a 2V facet using MSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a surface-mount analog amplifier IC in an MSOP package family.
Choose between AD8131ARMZ and LTC1992-2 series part variants with MSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm footprints.
Use when selecting tier-A parts from Alternate-KiCad-Library with a 2V facet.
avoid_when: Avoid if the PCB layout requires through-hole mounting instead of SMD.
Avoid when footprints other than MSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm are needed.
Avoid if the application does not match an analog amplifier IC with a 2V facet.
